title: The receiver probe does not stay blocked on an old refused Actions run
body:
Evidence: src/cli/lane-run/receiver.ts (#1449, f11db40) reads only the newest workflow run of the repository; once Actions works again, a refused run stays newest until something pushes, so probeReceiver keeps returning the refusal gap and every lane exits 72 before it can push a newer run.
Outcome: the refusal check looks only at runs newer than the last successful run on the base, or ignores a refused run older than a recent successful one, so a recovered receiver is ready again without a manual push.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/receiver.ts, test/cli/lane-run-receiver.test.ts
Proof: a receiver test with a refused run older than a green base run reports no gap.
